description: List the abaplint rules this server can check, optionally filtered by a free-text query or a tag, returning key, title, one-line description, tags and a documentation URL per rule. Use this when deciding which rules to enable or override in lint_abap, or to discover what a Clean-ABAP-style check exists for. It does not run any analysis and does not change configuration — it is a read-only catalog. Example: list_abap_rules({ "query": "obsolete" }).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against rule key, title and description, e.g. "select" or "obsolete".

name: list_abap_rules

key.description: Rule key, usable in lint_abap rules overrides.

title: List abaplint rules
